notes.title: Cyjin 1.0.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this update (Release 1.0.0.2), we have fixed some bugs in the previous version.

Bugs Fixed:
* Fix the inactive laser needles in some places.
* Fix some other minor bugs.

notes.title: Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja is coming to Steam on November 10th 2021!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja is coming to Steam in one week! We've been doing our best to make this game one of a kind.

[h3]CYJIN IS AVAILABLE ON STEAM 10 NOVEMBER 2021[/h3]

It's almost time to test your mouse skills!

And a new trailer!
[previewyoutube=QFkLstc1bXc;full][/previewyoutube]
